Documentation of COVID-19 Vaccination and/or Booster Records

Valid examples of vaccination and/or booster documentation include a COVID-19 Vaccination Record Card, QR Code from the State of California, or a letter from a healthcare provider.

Upload a copy of your medical or religious exemption at request.

guidetextdraw_copy._value:
Please Note:

  • Attachment does not support following special characters / \\ : * ? & { } ; [ ]
  • Only PDF files are allowed!
  • You can only upload one document type per submission. For example, if you have a Vaccination and a Booster record, you will need to upload each separately.
